bind_address.description: Network interface IP address to bind the HTTP server to.

http_port.description: HTTP port for the camera stream and web interface.

auth_enabled.description: Enable basic HTTP authentication for accessing the stream.

auth_users.description: List of users allowed to access the stream (only used if auth_enabled is true).

password_hash.description: BCrypt or SHA256 hashed password (never plain-text).

device_type.description: Source of video input. Use 'v4l2' for webcam, 'file' for static image loop.

v4l2_device.description: V4L2 device node (e.g., /dev/video0). Only used when device_type=v4l2.

v4l2_resolution.description: Video resolution as WIDTHxHEIGHT. Only used when device_type=v4l2.

v4l2_fps.description: Frames per second to capture. Only used when device_type=v4l2.

image_path.description: Path to static image file to stream in loop. Only used when device_type=file.

image_loop.description: Enable infinite looping of the static image. Only used when device_type=file.

stream_format.description: Output streaming format. 'mjpeg' for Motion JPEG, 'h264' for hardware-encoded H.264 (if supported).

mjpeg_quality.description: JPEG quality (0–100) for MJPEG stream. Higher = better quality, larger bandwidth. Only used when stream_format=mjpeg.

h264_profile.description: H.264 profile. Options: baseline, main, high. Only used when stream_format=h264.

h264_level.description: H.264 level (e.g., 3.1, 4.0, 4.1). Only used when stream_format=h264.

h264_bitrate.description: Target H.264 bitrate in kbps. Only used when stream_format=h264.

motion_detection_enabled.description: Enable motion detection on the video stream.

motion_sensitivity.description: Sensitivity of motion detection (0–100). Higher = more sensitive. Only used if motion_detection_enabled=true.

motion_min_area.description: Minimum pixel area of motion region to trigger alert. Only used if motion_detection_enabled=true.

motion_cooldown_secs.description: Seconds to wait between motion alerts. Only used if motion_detection_enabled=true.

motion_alert_url.description: HTTP(S) endpoint to POST motion alert JSON (e.g., http://localhost:3000/alerts). Optional; leave blank to disable external alerts. Only used if motion_detection_enabled=true.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity. Options: debug, info, warn, error.

log_file.description: Path to log file. Set to '-' to log to stdout.

webui_enabled.description: Enable the built-in web UI for status and configuration.

webui_path.description: URL path for the web UI (e.g., /webui or /).
